text: This Manville site is located outside the [[1%|assumed]] annual-chance floodplain. Heavy rainfall can still flood areas that maps miss, such as during Tropical Storm Ida in [[2021|measured]]. A today-scale [[100-year|assumed]], [[24-hour|assumed]] storm producing [[8.2 in|measured]] of rain is projected to become a [[25-year|modeled]] storm later this century.
